resources.string: Are you sure you want to delete the rule \'%1$s\'? This CANNOT BE UNDONE.
Below settings apply to all notifications
Below settings only apply to the notifications that match ALL of the following:

Master switch for all notifications matched by this rule

 • Show = Show notifications normally
 • Mute = Show notifications in the app, but do not popup or vibrate the watch
 • Hide = Hide notifications from the watch entirely
Mute notifications that would ordinarily not vibrate/make noise on the phone.
Mute notifications filtered by Do not disturb
Mute notifications that would be filtered by the phone\'s currently set Do not disturb mode.
Mute notification updates that have the same text as the previous notification.
Hide notifications that represent an ongoing event (such as a file download or a service running in the background).

Hide notifications that show a summary of other notifications (such as summary of all e-mails). These notifications are usually a duplicate as usually separate notifications for the individual items in the summary are present at the same time.
Hide notifications that are marked as local only (not meant to be bridged to other devices).
Hide notifications from media players meant for controlling media playback.
%1$s\n\nPattern that the watch will vibrate with for new notifications. A comma separated list corresponding to milliseconds vibrating, milliseconds pausing, milliseconds vibrating etc.
If Android provides a vibration pattern with the notification, use it on the watch unless a rule overrides it.
A list of options that show up on Reply action, in addition to the options already provided by the application.

Automatically apply app pause on all new notifications matched by this rule:\n\nAfter the first notification is received, the watch will not vibrate for any new notifications from this app until it is manually unpaused or until all notifications from this app are dismissed.
Automatically apply app pause on all new notifications matched by this rule:\n\nThe watch will not vibrate for any new messages in the conversation until it is manually unpaused or dismissed.

When enabled, after notification vibrates for the first time, it will also make a periodic short buzz. \n\nPressing any button will stop this until the next notification with this enabled is received.
Preset messages for notification replies on the watch.
Mute watch vibration for notifications filtered by the phone\'s Do Not Disturb mode.
Android marks some notifications as local only. Turn this on to forward them anyway.
Muted notifications are retained in the app history so they can help order the Notifications tab.
Auto-close notification popups after this many seconds. Set to 0 to leave them open.
Keep current notification while using watch
When enabled, new phone notifications are added to the top of the list without replacing the open notification if you pressed a watch button recently.
Seconds after a watch button press that a new notification should wait in the list instead of replacing the open notification. Set to 0 to always show the newest notification.
Skip watch alerts while phone is unlocked
When enabled, notifications received while the phone is unlocked are not sent to the watch and do not open the watch app.
Experimental firmware mode. Sends notifications to the built-in PebbleOS notification list instead of opening the companion watch app.
Here you can add Tasker tasks that will be added to the notification actions. When you select that task on the Pebble, Tasker task will be executed.
(You can refer to the captured groups with the $1, $2 etc.)
Replace some text in the notification with something else. This can be used to remove unimportant information or make important information more prominent.
